calendar.toggle: Bring the milestones into your calendar
calendar.google: Google Calendar: download the file and import it (Settings → Import & export). Google can't subscribe to an address on your computer, so import it again when your milestones change: events are updated, not duplicated.
calendar.others: Outlook, Apple Calendar or Thunderbird: subscribe to this address (it updates on its own while cai serve is running):

title: Processes
intro: Click “Update status” on a card (or drag it to another column) to log what happened: a reply, an interview, a rejection… Nothing changes column without its event. Interviews and tests create their milestone with a date.
